goal: Extract canonical Citi Bike rides and latest Pixel 8 backup, then integrate Citi Bike trips into master timeline with authentic multi-modal physics and strict stay protection.

steps.description: Scrape canonical Citi Bike rides (Aug 28 - Sep 21, 2026) directly from Citi Bike app UI into scratch/citibike_rides.db
Export or extract the restored Timeline backup from Pixel 8 and verify coverage up to yesterday
Integrate Citi Bike trips into timeline_viewer.db with authentic multi-modal physics, dock stops, and zero stay truncation
Verify temporal monotonicity, zero overlaps, stay protection on 2026-09-01/02, run test suites and API contract gates
Resolve all Citi Bike stations to canonical ChIJ Place IDs, snap approach/departure walk geometries, and eliminate river teleports
